designku.name: Tinta
designku.context: Creator tools, content and video editing, indie SaaS, startups
designku.tagline: Neo-brutalism: ink outlines and hard offset shadows on warm paper, bold but still accessible.
designku.audience: Creators, marketers and small teams who want a tool that feels confident and hand-made rather than corporate, and who return to it daily to make things.

rationale.color: Ported from the Cuplikin app. A saturated electric blue primary on an off-white, faintly green 'paper' background, with deep navy 'ink' for text, outlines and shadows instead of pure black, which keeps the brutalist contrast but softens it. Pastel mint, sky, peach and lavender containers act like highlighter marks for tags, credits and status, and the blue stays the only saturated color on screen. Dark mode switches to calm zinc greys and drops the hard shadow, because a light offset shadow on a dark surface looks like a rendering glitch.
rationale.typography: Jost headlines (geometric, Futura-like, with a poster feel) pair with Mulish body text, which stays highly legible at small sizes in dense editor UIs.
rationale.shape: Neo-brutalism: primary buttons, the FAB, elevated cards and dialogs get a 1.5px ink outline and a 3px hard shadow with zero blur. Pressing a button moves it into its shadow, so it feels physically pushed. Medium radii (12-16px) keep it friendly rather than raw. Everyday surfaces follow the app: cards, list groups, the search field and the bottom navigation are white with a 1px light line on the paper background (no grey fills), list thumbnails are solid pastel tiles, and chips are pills with a thin line. Secondary buttons, cards and inputs stay flat, so the raised treatment always marks the one thing to press.
rationale.motion: Snappy. The press-into-shadow translate is the main motion; everything else stays short.

do: Give the hard shadow only to the single primary action per region (DsButton filled/danger, FAB) and to elevated cards or dialogs; everything else stays flat with thin borders.
Use the pastel containers (primaryContainer = sky, tertiaryContainer = mint, warningContainer = peach) for badges, tags and credit or status chips.
Keep text and outlines in onSurface (ink); never use pure black.
dont: Do not hand-draw BoxShadow or borders in feature code. DsEffect and the Ds* atoms already apply the outline and hard shadow, and switch them off in dark mode.
Do not stack several raised (shadowed) elements next to each other; neo-brutalism loses hierarchy when everything pops.
Do not add blur to the shadow or color it with the brand blue; it is always a zero-blur ink offset.
